entries.topic: Jason Calacanis llama a Bitcoin 'red muerta' y recibe apuestas por $3M (Cardone, Krueger, Terence Michael)
entries.why: Debate viral con nombres grandes. Ángulo propio: en vez de opinar, mostrar el drawdown real desde el máximo y separar apuestas de convicción vs. tenencia spot.
entries.post:
Someone with 1M+ followers just called $BTC a "dead network."

Here's what the data says instead:

High: $126,198 (Oct 6, 2025)
Low: $57,740 (Jul 1, 2026)
Now: ~$80k, about 37% below the top.

That's a deep drawdown. It's also the kind $BTC has lived through before.

Million-dollar bets are entertainment. Holding spot, without leverage, is a decision you can actually survive.
cta: Bookmark this chart. Check it again in 12 months.
Repost if you'd rather argue with data than with hot takes.

entries.topic: Fed mantiene 3,75–4,00% en votación 10-2; los dos disidentes (Cook y Hammack) querían SUBIR la tasa
entries.why: Dato duro post-FOMC, nuevo respecto a la previa: el disenso fue hawkish. Ángulo macro claro para $BTC que pocos explican sin hype.
entries.post:
The Fed held rates yesterday. The interesting part was the vote.

10–2. And both dissents wanted a hike, not a cut.

Range stays at 3.75%–4.00%. The statement still calls inflation elevated.

Why it matters for $BTC: the "rate cuts are coming" tailwind isn't on the table right now.

If your thesis needs cheap money, it's a fragile thesis.
cta: Follow for macro read in plain English, no hype.
Bookmark to compare with the next FOMC.

entries.topic: Adolescente canadiense condenado por robar 185 BTC (~$13M) con falso soporte técnico; 25 meses de prisión
entries.why: Historia con gancho humano y lección de custodia muy guardable. Encaja con la postura de la cuenta: entender la custodia.
entries.post:
185 $BTC. One victim's life savings. Gone after one phone call.

A teen posing as tech support talked a California man out of ~$13M in March. He just got 25 months. Only $3.8M was returned.

No exploit. No hack of Bitcoin. Just trust.

3 rules:
1. No real support will ever ask for your seed.
2. Never move coins because someone called you.
3. Hang up and contact the company yourself.
cta: Bookmark this and send it to someone who holds $BTC.
Repost — this one might save someone's stack.

entries.topic: Corte Suprema de Tailandia: Bitcoin es propiedad bajo ley penal (robo de 2,48 BTC en Koh Samui)
entries.why: Adopción legal con historia concreta; ángulo diferenciado: 'propiedad' ≠ 'moneda de curso legal'. Bueno para bookmarks de quienes siguen regulación.
entries.post:
Can you legally "own" $BTC? Thailand's Supreme Court just said yes.

The case: 2.48 BTC taken at gunpoint on Koh Samui in 2022. The defense argued Bitcoin has no value.

The full bench disagreed. 10-year sentences upheld. Return the coins or pay ฿1.878M.

The nuance: property, not legal tender.

That's the status that matters most to a holder.
cta: Bookmark if you follow how courts treat $BTC.
Follow for adoption news with the fine print.

entries.topic: Bitwise sube su proyección 2036 para $BTC a $1,6M (base), con escenario bajista $131k y alcista $3,67M
entries.why: Número grande que circula mucho; ángulo de valor: mostrar el rango completo y el supuesto (34,3% anual) en vez del titular.
entries.post:
Bitwise now sees $BTC at $1.6M by 2036. Up from $1.3M.

The headline skips the range:
Bear: $131k
Base: $1.6M
Bull: $3.67M

The base case assumes ~34.3% growth per year, for ten years.

A forecast with a 28x spread between bear and bull isn't a price target. It's a map of uncertainty.

Useful. Just don't size a position on the middle number.
cta: Bookmark it and check back in 2036.
Repost if you prefer ranges over headlines.

entries.topic: Senador Hagerty: EE.UU. podría ampliar pronto su reserva de 200.000 BTC, tras aprobarse la ley de estructura de mercado
entries.why: Tema de adopción estatal con mucho alcance; ángulo sobrio: separar declaraciones de compras reales (condicional, sin financiamiento definido).
entries.post:
The US government holds ~200,000 $BTC. Will it buy more?

Sen. Bill Hagerty says expansion could come "very soon" and that there are no plans to sell.

The catch: it depends on market-structure legislation that's stalled in the Senate. And funding isn't defined.

A statement is not a purchase.

Watch the bill, not the soundbite.
cta: Follow to get the update when there's an actual vote.

entries.topic: 3 ballenas depositaron 6.168 BTC (~$498M) en Coinbase Prime antes de la Fed
entries.why: Dato on-chain que genera miedo de venta; ángulo educativo: un depósito a custodia institucional no es una venta.
entries.post:
~$498M in $BTC just moved to Coinbase Prime. Panic?

6,168 BTC from three wallets, hours before the Fed.

But Coinbase Prime is custody plus trading for institutions. A deposit can be a sale, an ETF rebalance, or just a custody change.

On-chain data shows where coins went. Not why.

Wait for the follow-up before you trade the headline.
cta: Bookmark this for the next "whale dump" headline.
